dialogues.speaker: Qiyong
dialogues.text: The enemies in that Domain can't be understood like we would common foes. Stay on your guard, and pay attention to their attacks!

dialogues.speaker: Qiyong
dialogues.text: Oh, it's you, bold hero. Have you any new orders?

response.speaker: Qiyong
response.text: Ah, Captain Fangjin told us that you came to our aid after learning of our plight...

response.speaker: Qiyong
response.text: Despite knowing the dangers within the Ley Line's Domain, you showed no fear — instead, you pressed forward relentlessly to storm the enemy stronghold...

response.speaker: Qiyong
response.text: To us, you're the model example of what a chivalrous hero should be!

choices.text: Aw, shucks, I just like helping people!

response.speaker: Qiyong
response.text: You're too humble! If you don't mind, I'd love to get some pointers about swordsmanship from you...

response.speaker: Qiyong
response.text: But our charge is to stay vigilant and be ready to engage the enemy at any time. I suppose our conversations on bladework will have to wait.

choices.text: That goes for all of you heroes as well.
Your task is to stay here?

response.speaker: Qiyong
response.text: That's right. Captain Fangjin has confirmed that we'll be cooperating with you long-term. If you should need us to, we'll do everything we can to assist you in battle.

response.speaker: Qiyong
response.text: That said, even though our lines are secure for the nonce, we cannot abandon our posts. If you plan to engage other monsters nearby, we may not be able to back you up.

choices.text: It won't come to that. Make sure to hold the fort here!

response.speaker: Qiyong
response.text: Indeed! We have full faith that you will deal with the threat before us meticulously, even should many such circumstances prove no challenge to you.

choices.text: Guarding the site of the disturbance is our core objective!
I'll leave you to your lookout duties. Stay vigilant!

response.speaker: Qiyong
response.text: You're so considerate of your allies... You've got the makings of a general!

dialogues.speaker: Qiyong
dialogues.text: A new round of combat is upon us... Ah, I'm so excited!

dialogues.speaker: Qiyong
dialogues.text: I wonder how long I can last in the Domain this time...

choices.text: Aren't you supposed to defend the outside?

response.speaker: Qiyong
response.text: You know what they say — the best defense is sometimes a good offense. No point sitting on our hands here if there are no monsters to fight.

response.speaker: Qiyong
response.text: When the disturbance first became active, we organized our best scouts to breach the affected areas. They brought back quite a bit of valuable intel.

response.speaker: Qiyong
response.text: Rarely do we get to test ourselves in battle. If it were my old team, I think we would have been tripping over each other to rush the enemy!

response.speaker: Qiyong
response.text: Don't worry, we know our limits.

response.speaker: Qiyong
response.text: It's essential for a warrior to assess the strength of both their enemies and allies.

response.speaker: Qiyong
response.text: But until we reach our limits, we should fear nothing. Instead, we should strike steady and strike true.

response.speaker: Qiyong
response.text: And if that foe proves too much to handle, one should never rush in. Instead, we should cover each other and disengage in good order, awaiting reinforcements or for a better opportunity to present itself.

response.speaker: Qiyong
response.text: Well... look at me rambling away. The long and short of it is that we'll take the initiative in battle!

choices.text: Me too. Be careful out there!

response.speaker: Qiyong
response.text: It's an honor to fight by your side... Ahh, I'm burning with excitement here!
